## getPermit2TransferFromTypedData() function

Builds Permit2 signature-transfer typed data for signing.

**Signature:**

```typescript
getPermit2TransferFromTypedData: (args: Permit2TransferFromArgs, chainId: ChainId) => TypedDataDefinition<typeof permit2TransferFromTypes, "PermitTransferFrom">
```

## Example


```ts
import { ChainId } from "@morpho-org/blue-sdk";
import { getPermit2TransferFromTypedData } from "@morpho-org/blue-sdk-viem";

const typedData = getPermit2TransferFromTypedData(
```
